title: [ingest] intersphinx_cache_limit is measured in days (multiplied by 86400)
summary: `intersphinx_cache_limit` defaults to `5` (days). The expiry calculation is `now - intersphinx_cache_limit * 86400`. Setting it to `0` disables expiry checks (the `>= 0` guard triggers but `cache_time` comparison never fires). Negative values also effectively disable the cache — undocumented behavior.
